evidence:
Workbook row 42 requires that worse apps never outscore better apps; Internal Quality Checks!E43 explicitly says to monitor this. Source inspection supports coordinatewise monotonicity, but does not measure product-quality ordering. Frozen tests/scoring.toml:1-11 gives zero-mass gates and positive functional/polish/visual weights 0.6/0.2/0.2 with functional floor 0.05. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 uses positive weighted mean, strict gate/floor thresholds, and rounding; increasing a correctly observed score cannot lower this arithmetic result. Independently parsed all scored criteria: functional 74 rows / total weight 32.25, polish 6 / 3.0, visual 6 / 6.0, all weights positive. Scoring.toml and score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba and 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e).

Adversarial source exercise: a visually identical partial app that executes/saves normally but loses the good preview after loop timeout must lose cw_literal_loop_rollback (functional judge.toml:171-175, weight 0.75) while independently retaining valid recovery observations (514-518); an otherwise identical corrected app can recover 0.6*0.75/32.25 = 0.01395349 of unrounded reward. A dead Auto-run feature cannot gain idle/cancel credit because both negative rows require an actual successful Auto-run control (302-315). These are conditional arithmetic/criterion arguments, not measured app scores. A conforming alternate using server-rendered library data, native controls, static restored snapshots and a different layout is expressly allowed by constraints judge.toml, app_context.md, and polish/visual prompts; no source-proven false gate from those alternatives was established. Actual weak-app versus conforming-app judge comparison remains unperformed.

Required runtime evidence is missing: runtime-evidence.json is absent, and raw-evidence-index.json:573-577 expressly lists Full configured judge completion/workload and Empirical configured reward floor/ranking as not measured. I verified all 527 indexed artifact hashes with no mismatch; index SHA256 at reading was 0ce9a42ec24081625d883e612da454dd619a63d492eec16f3af5588cd13b1cc6. The current golden host RESULT.json:27 says provider_or_platform=false, and golden RESULTS.json:3-5 identifies direct pinned Playwright rather than the configured judge; oracle_score_claimed=false at line 25388. final-source-checks/RESULTS.json:27-31 says provider_invoked=false and judge_launched=false. The indexed original-successful_grade control is synthetic: its suite.sh directly writes functional=0.5/polish=1/visual=1, and its rewardkit.log says diagnostic-scored. None supplies empirical configured ranking. Per qc/README.md:27-31 and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:31, this required measurement gap prevents Pass even though no arithmetic inversion was found. No provider run, upload, task edit or other reviewer finding was used.
suggested_fix: Obtain authorized, hash-bound full configured judge results for the current candidate on a conforming reference/alternative and controlled weaker variants with unchanged presentation; compare criterion observations and final rewards, including gate/floor cases, and record actual commands/log hashes under reward_ranking_is_monotone. Preserve shared scoring policy; investigate any observed inversion before clearance.
